sql:
SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Magnet
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE 
    f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1
    AND sa.NumTstTakr > 500
    AND (s.Magnet = 1 OR s.GSoffered LIKE '%Magnet%');
